issue.title: Pager close and unsplit detach the surviving view from the widget tree
issue.description: Reproduced on sase HEAD 47907502b6932734221302dc6f4706b6034422d4 with Textual 8.0.1. In a SasePager run_test at 120x40, press backslash to split, then either backslash to unsplit or q to close the focused pane. Before closing: two tracked views and two container children. After either path: one tracked survivor with parent=None, zero pager-panes children and zero PagerView widgets in the screen query. The survivor is_mounted flag still reads True, so that flag alone misses the broken widget tree. Root cause: PagerScreenSplitMixin.close_view and the same-layout branch of _toggle_split await pager-panes.remove_children() then retain a survivor reference without remounting it. Remove only the discarded view; preserve the survivor, workers, reading anchor, labels and focused chrome. Add a Pilot assertion that the survivor remains a child of pager-panes, renders content and accepts scrolling after q, Esc, exhausted Backspace and same-key unsplit. Existing test_q_closes_focused_pane_then_pager only checks len(screen.views) and layout.

task_type_fields.impact: Closing or collapsing a split leaves an empty pager body while internal view counts look correct.
task_type_fields.repro: SasePager long document; run_test(size=(120,40)); press backslash, then backslash or q; inspect focused_view.parent, pager-panes.children and screen.query(PagerView)

issue.creation_reason: Independently reproduced while researching three-pane layouts. The existing two-pane teardown leaves no displayed PagerView, so it must be repaired before extending pane management.

evidence.note: Independent repro (research.3b.cld, master 47907502b6, Textual 8.0.1): SasePager(long_document()) at 80x20, press | then | (same-key unsplit) -> screen.query('#pager-body') is empty and exported screenshot no longer contains body text 'line 1' (it did before the split). Also reproduced at 120x40 for q and backslash paths: #pager-panes children 0, survivor in DOM False while is_mounted stays True. Blocks any 3-pane pane-management work since every close/delete path goes through the same remove_children() call.
